records.title: VersusQ: Pairwise Margin Reasoning for Generalizable Video Quality Assessment
records.reason: VersusQ evaluates video quality with multimodal models and pairwise reasoning. The paper targets assessment accuracy/generalization and presents no inference efficiency or serving technique.

records.title: ChunkFT: Byte-Streamed Optimization for Memory-Efficient Full Fine-Tuning
records.reason: ChunkFT reduces memory and gradient work during full fine-tuning by byte-streamed/chunked optimization. Its studied savings occur during training, not LLM inference or serving, so the linked inference scope is not technically supported.

records.title: Omega‐3 DHA as a blank canvas: A molecular approximation to how lipid mediators modulate LGR6 in inflammation resolution
records.reason: linked lineageがある候補だが、一次出版社本文を取得できず、対象系統との関係を一次証拠で確定できない。二次ページやpacket要旨だけでunrelated/followupと断定できないためborderline。一次資料へのアクセスが得られた場合に再判定する。

records.title: LatentBox: Storing AI-Generated Images at Scale via a Latent-First Design
records.reason: LatentBox is an image-generation storage system that stores compressed image latents and decodes on demand to reduce persistent storage. The optimization is image-data storage/decoding, not LLM model inference or serving.

records.title: Introspective X Training: Feedback Conditioning Improves Scaling Across all LLM Training Stages
records.reason: Introspective X Training conditions model training on rubric-derived feedback across pretraining and supervised fine-tuning. The contribution and evaluations concern training outcomes rather than inference-time efficiency or serving.
